problem:
Consider the straight line given by the following parametric equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x=5-9t \\ y=-2+7t \\ z=-8t\end{aligned}
$$

What would be the vector equation of the line?

feedback.problem:
Consider the straight line given by the following parametric equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x=2+4t \\ y=\frac{3}{4}-2t \\ z=3+t\end{aligned}
$$

What would be the vector equation of the line?
feedback.worked_solution:
These parametric equations are equivalent to

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2+4t \\ \frac{3}{4}-2t \\ 3+t\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ \frac{3}{4} \\ 3\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}4t \\ -2t \\ t\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ \frac{3}{4} \\ 3\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ r & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ \frac{3}{4} \\ 3\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\end{aligned}
$$

where $t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).$
